title: ARMS & GENTLE CORE
subtitle: FRIDAY KIND. LIGHT ARMS. SOFT MIDDLE.

script.welcome: Hello Pam. I'm Stratton. Friday is light arms and a gentle core — a short, kind break from the chair. About eleven minutes. If a joint is sore, take a smaller range. Showing up is the win.
script.start: Whenever you're ready. Easy breath. This is meant to feel doable.
script.nextExercise: Next one. Shake it out if you like. No rush.
script.rest: Have a little rest. Breathe easy.
script.lastSet: Last set. Make it comfortable and clean.
script.complete: That's us. Lovely work. Light arms, a soft middle, and you showed up. Enjoy your Friday — see you tomorrow.
script.resume: Back with you. Easy as we go.

exercises.name: WALL PUSH UPS
exercises.cue: Stand facing a wall, feet about an arm's length away. Hands on the wall at shoulder height, soft belly. Bend the elbows and lower the chest gently toward the wall, then press back. Soft neck. A smaller range is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Wall push ups for light arms. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, hands on the wall, lower gently, then press back. Soft neck. Smaller range is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Wall push ups done. Well done.

exercises.name: SEATED OVERHEAD PRESS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Hands at shoulder height with light weights or empty hands. Press gently upward only as far as feels kind, then lower with control. Soft neck. A smaller press is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated overhead press for light shoulders. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, press gently upward only as far as feels kind, then lower. Soft neck. Smaller press is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the shoulders. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED ROW
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly. Elbows bent, hands forward as if holding light weights or a band. Draw the elbows back gently and squeeze the shoulder blades together a little, then ease forward with control. Soft neck. A smaller squeeze is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated row to balance the push. Two sets of eight. Soft belly, draw the elbows back and squeeze the shoulder blades a little, then ease forward. Soft neck. Smaller squeeze is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty five seconds. Soften the upper back. Easy breath.

exercises.name: SEATED KNEE LIFTS
exercises.cue: Sit tall near the front of a sturdy chair, feet flat. Soft belly — that little brace is your gentle core. Lift one knee a little toward the ceiling, then lower with control. Alternate sides. Soft neck. A smaller lift is perfect on a sore day.
exercises.speakStart: Seated knee lifts for a gentle core finish. Two sets of eight each leg. Soft belly, lift one knee a little, then lower with control. Soft neck. Smaller lift is fine.
exercises.speakRest: Twenty seconds. Soften the middle. Easy breath.
exercises.speakDone: Knee lifts done. That's the session — lovely work.
